name: LT - Report Executive Summary API
description: Returns the executive summary payload from Postgres with channel, UTM, pipeline, health, funnel-efficiency, and attribution-coverage metrics for the embedded report.

parameters.jsCode: const req = $node['Webhook Intake'].json || {}; const q = req.query || {}; const cfg = $node['Config'].json || {}; const timezone = String(cfg.timezone || 'America/Los_Angeles'); const view = String(q.view || 'overview'); const range = String(q.range || '30d'); const from = q.from ? String(q.from) : ''; const to = q.to ? String(q.to) : ''; function isoDate(date) { return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10); } function subtractDays(date, days) { var d = new Date(date.getTime()); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - days); return d; } var map = { '7d': 7, '30d': 30, '90d': 90 }; var endDate = to || isoDate(new Date()); var startDate = from; if (!startDate) { var days = map[range] || 30; startDate = isoDate(subtractDays(new Date(endDate + 'T00:00:00Z'), days - 1)); } return [{ json: { workflowName: String(cfg.workflowName || 'LT - Report Executive Summary API'), timezone, view, range, from, to, startDate, endDate } }];

return [{ json: { ...$json, queryText: `WITH summary AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sessions), 0)::int AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(users), 0)::int AS users, COALESCE(SUM(new_users), 0)::int AS new_users, COALESCE(SUM(engaged_sessions), 0)::int AS engaged_sessions,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(sessions), 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(engaged_sessions), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 4) END AS engagement_rate,
    COALESCE(SUM(gsc_clicks), 0)::int AS gsc_clicks, COALESCE(SUM(gsc_impressions), 0)::int AS gsc_impressions,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(gsc_impressions), 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gsc_clicks), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(gsc_impressions), 0), 4) END AS gsc_ctr,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gsc_position), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) END AS gsc_position,
    COALESCE(SUM(contacts_created), 0)::int AS contacts_created, COALESCE(SUM(form_submissions), 0)::int AS form_submissions, COALESCE(SUM(opportunities_created), 0)::int AS opportunities_created,
    COALESCE(SUM(meetings_booked), 0)::int AS meetings_booked, COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_count), 0)::int AS closed_won_count, COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_revenue), 0)::numeric(18,2) AS closed_won_revenue,
    COALESCE(SUM(closed_lost_count), 0)::int AS closed_lost_count
  FROM report_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
),
contact_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT source_key AS stored_contact_key, COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), REPLACE(source_key, 'contact:', '')) AS ghl_contact_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'utmSessionSource', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'source', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'source', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source', ''), '') AS source_hint,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'medium', ''), '') AS medium_hint,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'campaign', ''), '') AS campaign_hint
  FROM report_raw_ghl_contacts c
  WHERE DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(c.payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(c.payload_json->>'dateAdded', '')::timestamptz, NOW())) BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
),
bridge_matches AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') AS ghl_contact_id
  FROM report_bridge_traffic_to_lead
  WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    AND COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') <> ''
    AND (
      COALESCE(NULLIF(traffic_source, 'unknown'), '') <> '' OR
      COALESCE(NULLIF(medium, 'unknown'), '') <> '' OR
      COALESCE(NULLIF(campaign, 'unknown'), '') <> '' OR
      COALESCE(NULLIF(landing_page, 'unknown'), '') <> ''
    )
),
lead_sale_matches AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') AS ghl_contact_id
  FROM report_bridge_lead_to_sale
  WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    AND COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') <> ''
),
coverage AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS cohort_contacts,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_hint <> '' OR medium_hint <> '' OR campaign_hint <> '')::int AS contacts_with_source_fields,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bm_raw.ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL OR bm_prefixed.ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS contacts_with_bridge_match,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lsm_raw.ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL OR lsm_prefixed.ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS contacts_with_sale_match
  FROM contact_cohort cc
  LEFT JOIN bridge_matches bm_raw ON bm_raw.ghl_contact_id = cc.ghl_contact_id
  LEFT JOIN bridge_matches bm_prefixed ON bm_prefixed.ghl_contact_id = cc.stored_contact_key
  LEFT JOIN lead_sale_matches lsm_raw ON lsm_raw.ghl_contact_id = cc.ghl_contact_id
  LEFT JOIN lead_sale_matches lsm_prefixed ON lsm_prefixed.ghl_contact_id = cc.stored_contact_key
),
funnel_contacts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o_contact_id)::int AS opportunity_contact_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o_contact_id) FILTER (WHERE is_meeting = 1)::int AS meeting_contact_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o_contact_id) FILTER (WHERE is_won = 1)::int AS won_contact_count
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact.id', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contactId', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contact_id', '')) AS o_contact_id,
      CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_name', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'pipelineStageName', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'stage', ''), '')) IN ('booked', 'discovery scheduled', 'meeting requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_meeting,
      CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_name', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'pipelineStageName', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'stage', ''), '')) = 'closed won' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'status', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'status', ''), '')) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_won
    FROM report_raw_ghl_opportunities o
    INNER JOIN contact_cohort cc ON cc.ghl_contact_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact.id', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contactId', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contact_id', ''))
  ) matched_opps
),
metric_summary AS (
  SELECT s.*, COALESCE(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0) AS opportunity_contact_count, COALESCE(f.meeting_contact_count, 0) AS meeting_contact_count, COALESCE(f.won_contact_count, 0) AS won_contact_count,
    COALESCE(c.cohort_contacts, 0) AS cohort_contacts, COALESCE(c.contacts_with_source_fields, 0) AS contacts_with_source_fields, COALESCE(c.contacts_with_bridge_match, 0) AS contacts_with_bridge_match, COALESCE(c.contacts_with_sale_match, 0) AS contacts_with_sale_match,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sessions, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(s.contacts_created, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.sessions, 0), 4) END AS session_to_contact_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.contacts_created, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.contacts_created, 0), 4) END AS contact_to_opportunity_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(f.meeting_contact_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0), 4) END AS opportunity_to_meeting_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.meeting_contact_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(f.won_contact_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(f.meeting_contact_count, 0), 4) END AS meeting_to_closed_won_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sessions, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(s.form_submissions, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.sessions, 0), 4) END AS session_to_form_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.cohort_contacts, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(c.contacts_with_source_fields, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(c.cohort_contacts, 0), 4) END AS contact_source_coverage_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.cohort_contacts, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(c.contacts_with_bridge_match, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(c.cohort_contacts, 0), 4) END AS contact_bridge_match_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(c.contacts_with_sale_match, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0), 4) END AS opportunity_match_coverage_rate
  FROM summary s CROSS JOIN funnel_contacts f CROSS JOIN coverage c
),
channels AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.sessions DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    SELECT channel, traffic_source, source, medium, SUM(sessions)::int AS sessions, SUM(users)::int AS users, SUM(new_users)::int AS new_users, SUM(leads)::int AS leads, SUM(opportunities)::int AS opportunities, COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_revenue), 0)::numeric(18,2) AS closed_won_revenue
    FROM report_channel_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date GROUP BY channel, traffic_source, source, medium ORDER BY SUM(sessions) DESC LIMIT 8
  ) t
),
utm_breakdown AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.sessions DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    SELECT source, medium, campaign, content, landing_page, SUM(sessions)::int AS sessions, SUM(leads)::int AS leads, SUM(opportunities)::int AS opportunities, COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_revenue), 0)::numeric(18,2) AS closed_won_revenue
    FROM report_utm_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date GROUP BY source, medium, campaign, content, landing_page ORDER BY SUM(sessions) DESC LIMIT 15
  ) t
),
meta_contact_attribution AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.contacts DESC, t.opportunities DESC, t.booked_contacts DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    WITH meta_contacts AS (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(c.payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'utmSessionSource', ''), NULLIF(c.payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'source', ''), NULLIF(c.payload_json->>'source', ''), '') AS source,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(c.payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'medium', ''), '') AS medium,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(c.payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'campaign', ''), '') AS campaign,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_last', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_content_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_content_last', ''), '') AS content,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_last', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_landing_page_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_landing_page_last', ''), '') AS landing_page,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), REPLACE(c.source_key, 'contact:', '')) AS ghl_contact_id
      FROM report_raw_ghl_contacts c
      WHERE DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(c.payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(c.payload_json->>'dateAdded', '')::timestamptz, NOW())) BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    ),
    matched_opps AS (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact.id', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contactId', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contact_id', '')) AS ghl_contact_id,
        o.source_key AS opportunity_id,
        CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_name', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'pipelineStageName', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'stage', ''), '')) IN ('booked', 'discovery scheduled', 'meeting requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_booked
      FROM report_raw_ghl_opportunities o
      WHERE DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'lastStatusChangeAt', '')::timestamptz, NOW())) BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    )
    SELECT
      NULLIF(mc.source, '') AS source,
      NULLIF(mc.medium, '') AS medium,
      NULLIF(mc.campaign, '') AS campaign,
      NULLIF(mc.content, '') AS content,
      NULLIF(mc.landing_page, '') AS landing_page,
      COUNT(DISTINCT mc.ghl_contact_id)::int AS contacts,
      COUNT(DISTINCT mo.opportunity_id)::int AS opportunities,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mo.is_booked = 1 THEN mc.ghl_contact_id END)::int AS booked_contacts
    FROM meta_contacts mc
    LEFT JOIN matched_opps mo ON mo.ghl_contact_id = mc.ghl_contact_id
    WHERE mc.ghl_contact_id <> ''
      AND (
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.source, '')) IN ('facebook', 'instagram', 'meta', 'fb', 'ig', 'an') OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.medium, '')) LIKE '%facebook%' OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.medium, '')) LIKE '%instagram%' OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.medium, '')) LIKE '%meta%' OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.medium, '')) LIKE '%leadform%' OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.campaign, '')) LIKE '%meta%' OR
        COALESCE(mc.landing_page, '') LIKE '%utm_id=%' OR
        COALESCE(mc.landing_page, '') LIKE '%utm_source=an%'
      )
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT mc.ghl_contact_id) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT mo.opportunity_id) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mo.is_booked = 1 THEN mc.ghl_contact_id END) DESC
    LIMIT 12
  ) t
),
stage_daily AS (
  SELECT x.report_date, x.pipeline, x.stage, x.stage_count, GREATEST(x.stage_count - COALESCE(x.prev_stage_count, 0), 0)::int AS moved_in_count, GREATEST(COALESCE(x.prev_stage_count, 0) - x.stage_count, 0)::int AS moved_out_count, x.won_count, x.lost_count
  FROM (
    SELECT report_date, pipeline, stage, stage_count, won_count, lost_count, LAG(stage_count) OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline, stage ORDER BY report_date) AS prev_stage_count FROM report_stage_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
  ) x
),
pipelines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.moved_out_count DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    SELECT pipeline, SUM(stage_count)::int AS stage_count, SUM(moved_in_count)::int AS moved_in_count, SUM(moved_out_count)::int AS moved_out_count, SUM(won_count)::int AS won_count, SUM(lost_count)::int AS lost_count FROM stage_daily GROUP BY pipeline ORDER BY SUM(moved_out_count) DESC, SUM(stage_count) DESC
  ) t
),
stages AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.moved_out_count DESC, t.stage_count DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    SELECT pipeline, stage, SUM(stage_count)::int AS stage_count, SUM(moved_in_count)::int AS moved_in_count, SUM(moved_out_count)::int AS moved_out_count, SUM(won_count)::int AS won_count, SUM(lost_count)::int AS lost_count FROM stage_daily GROUP BY pipeline, stage ORDER BY SUM(moved_out_count) DESC, SUM(stage_count) DESC LIMIT 10
  ) t
),
health AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.source_system), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    SELECT source_system, status, last_success_at, last_attempt_at, last_row_count, stale_after_hours, last_error FROM report_source_health WHERE source_system <> 'undefined' ORDER BY source_system
  ) t
),
social_posts AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'totalPosts', COUNT(*)::int,
    'publishedCount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('published','scheduled'))::int,
    'failedCount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) = 'failed')::int,
    'facebookCount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(platform) LIKE '%facebook%' OR LOWER(platform) = 'fb')::int,
    'instagramCount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(platform) LIKE '%instagram%' OR LOWER(platform) = 'ig')::int,
    'linkedinCount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(platform) LIKE '%linkedin%' OR LOWER(platform) = 'li')::int,
    'totalLikes', COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((insights->>'likes')::int, 0)), 0),
    'totalComments', COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((insights->>'comments')::int, 0)), 0),
    'totalShares', COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((insights->>'shares')::int, 0)), 0)
  ) AS payload
  FROM report_raw_ghl_social_posts
),
landing_pages AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0)::int AS item_count, COALESCE(SUM(sessions), 0)::int AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(form_submissions), 0)::int AS form_submissions FROM report_landing_page_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
),
summary_json AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'traffic', CASE WHEN (SELECT sessions FROM metric_summary) > 0 THEN (SELECT sessions FROM metric_summary)::text ELSE 'GA4 pending' END,
    'leads', (SELECT contacts_created FROM metric_summary)::text,
    'sales', (SELECT closed_won_count FROM metric_summary)::text,
    'trafficNumeric', (SELECT sessions FROM metric_summary), 'leadsNumeric', (SELECT contacts_created FROM metric_summary), 'salesNumeric', (SELECT closed_won_count FROM metric_summary), 'closedWonRevenue', (SELECT closed_won_revenue FROM metric_summary), 'users', (SELECT users FROM metric_summary), 'newUsers', (SELECT new_users FROM metric_summary), 'engagedSessions', (SELECT engaged_sessions FROM metric_summary), 'engagementRate', (SELECT engagement_rate FROM metric_summary), 'gscClicks', (SELECT gsc_clicks FROM metric_summary), 'gscImpressions', (SELECT gsc_impressions FROM metric_summary), 'gscCtr', (SELECT gsc_ctr FROM metric_summary), 'gscPosition', (SELECT gsc_position FROM metric_summary), 'contactsCreated', (SELECT contacts_created FROM metric_summary), 'formSubmissions', (SELECT form_submissions FROM metric_summary), 'opportunitiesCreated', (SELECT opportunities_created FROM metric_summary), 'opportunityContactCount', (SELECT opportunity_contact_count FROM metric_summary), 'meetingsBooked', (SELECT meetings_booked FROM metric_summary), 'closedWonCount', (SELECT closed_won_count FROM metric_summary), 'closedLostCount', (SELECT closed_lost_count FROM metric_summary), 'sessionToContactRate', (SELECT session_to_contact_rate FROM metric_summary), 'contactToOpportunityRate', (SELECT contact_to_opportunity_rate FROM metric_summary), 'opportunityToMeetingRate', (SELECT opportunity_to_meeting_rate FROM metric_summary), 'meetingToClosedWonRate', (SELECT meeting_to_closed_won_rate FROM metric_summary), 'sessionToFormRate', (SELECT session_to_form_rate FROM metric_summary), 'contactSourceCoverageRate', (SELECT contact_source_coverage_rate FROM metric_summary), 'contactBridgeMatchRate', (SELECT contact_bridge_match_rate FROM metric_summary), 'opportunityMatchCoverageRate', (SELECT opportunity_match_coverage_rate FROM metric_summary), 'cohortContacts', (SELECT cohort_contacts FROM metric_summary), 'contactsWithSourceFields', (SELECT contacts_with_source_fields FROM metric_summary), 'contactsWithBridgeMatch', (SELECT contacts_with_bridge_match FROM metric_summary), 'contactsWithSaleMatch', (SELECT contacts_with_sale_match FROM metric_summary), 'trafficGapLandingPages', (SELECT item_count FROM landing_pages), 'trafficGapSessions', (SELECT sessions FROM landing_pages), 'trafficGapFormSubmissions', (SELECT form_submissions FROM landing_pages)
  ) AS payload
)
SELECT json_build_object('window', json_build_object('from', $1::date, 'to', $2::date), 'summary', (SELECT to_jsonb(summary_json.payload) FROM summary_json), 'channelBreakdown', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM channels), '[]'::json), 'utmBreakdown', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM utm_breakdown), '[]'::json), 'metaAttribution', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM meta_contact_attribution), '[]'::json), 'pipelineDropoff', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM pipelines), '[]'::json), 'stageDropoff', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM stages), '[]'::json), 'stageVelocity', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(v.*) ORDER BY v.avg_days_in_stage DESC), '[]'::json) FROM report_stage_velocity_summary v), 'socialPosts', COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(social_posts.payload) FROM social_posts), '{}'::jsonb), 'health', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM health), '[]'::json)) AS payload;` } }];

const req = $node['Webhook Intake'].json || {}; const q = req.query || {}; const cfg = $node['Config'].json || {}; const timezone = String(cfg.timezone || 'America/Los_Angeles'); const view = String(q.view || 'overview'); const range = String(q.range || '30d'); const from = q.from ? String(q.from) : ''; const to = q.to ? String(q.to) : ''; function isoDate(date) { return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10); } function subtractDays(date, days) { var d = new Date(date.getTime()); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - days); return d; } var map = { '7d': 7, '30d': 30, '90d': 90 }; var endDate = to || isoDate(new Date()); var startDate = from; if (!startDate) { var days = map[range] || 30; startDate = isoDate(subtractDays(new Date(endDate + 'T00:00:00Z'), days - 1)); } return [{ json: { workflowName: String(cfg.workflowName || 'LT - Report Executive Summary API'), timezone, view, range, from, to, startDate, endDate } }];

return [{ json: { ...$json, queryText: `WITH summary AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sessions), 0)::int AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(users), 0)::int AS users, COALESCE(SUM(new_users), 0)::int AS new_users, COALESCE(SUM(engaged_sessions), 0)::int AS engaged_sessions,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(sessions), 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(engaged_sessions), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 4) END AS engagement_rate,
    COALESCE(SUM(gsc_clicks), 0)::int AS gsc_clicks, COALESCE(SUM(gsc_impressions), 0)::int AS gsc_impressions,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(gsc_impressions), 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gsc_clicks), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(gsc_impressions), 0), 4) END AS gsc_ctr,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gsc_position), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) END AS gsc_position,
    COALESCE(SUM(contacts_created), 0)::int AS contacts_created, COALESCE(SUM(form_submissions), 0)::int AS form_submissions, COALESCE(SUM(opportunities_created), 0)::int AS opportunities_created,
    COALESCE(SUM(meetings_booked), 0)::int AS meetings_booked, COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_count), 0)::int AS closed_won_count, COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_revenue), 0)::numeric(18,2) AS closed_won_revenue,
    COALESCE(SUM(closed_lost_count), 0)::int AS closed_lost_count
  FROM report_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
),
contact_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT source_key AS stored_contact_key, COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), REPLACE(source_key, 'contact:', '')) AS ghl_contact_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'utmSessionSource', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'source', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'source', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source', ''), '') AS source_hint,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'medium', ''), '') AS medium_hint,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'campaign', ''), '') AS campaign_hint
  FROM report_raw_ghl_contacts c
  WHERE DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(c.payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(c.payload_json->>'dateAdded', '')::timestamptz, NOW())) BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
),
bridge_matches AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') AS ghl_contact_id
  FROM report_bridge_traffic_to_lead
  WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    AND COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') <> ''
    AND (
      COALESCE(NULLIF(traffic_source, 'unknown'), '') <> '' OR
      COALESCE(NULLIF(medium, 'unknown'), '') <> '' OR
      COALESCE(NULLIF(campaign, 'unknown'), '') <> '' OR
      COALESCE(NULLIF(landing_page, 'unknown'), '') <> ''
    )
),
lead_sale_matches AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') AS ghl_contact_id
  FROM report_bridge_lead_to_sale
  WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    AND COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') <> ''
),
coverage AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS cohort_contacts,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_hint <> '' OR medium_hint <> '' OR campaign_hint <> '')::int AS contacts_with_source_fields,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bm_raw.ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL OR bm_prefixed.ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS contacts_with_bridge_match,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lsm_raw.ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL OR lsm_prefixed.ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS contacts_with_sale_match
  FROM contact_cohort cc
  LEFT JOIN bridge_matches bm_raw ON bm_raw.ghl_contact_id = cc.ghl_contact_id
  LEFT JOIN bridge_matches bm_prefixed ON bm_prefixed.ghl_contact_id = cc.stored_contact_key
  LEFT JOIN lead_sale_matches lsm_raw ON lsm_raw.ghl_contact_id = cc.ghl_contact_id
  LEFT JOIN lead_sale_matches lsm_prefixed ON lsm_prefixed.ghl_contact_id = cc.stored_contact_key
),
funnel_contacts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o_contact_id)::int AS opportunity_contact_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o_contact_id) FILTER (WHERE is_meeting = 1)::int AS meeting_contact_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o_contact_id) FILTER (WHERE is_won = 1)::int AS won_contact_count
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact.id', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contactId', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contact_id', '')) AS o_contact_id,
      CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_name', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'pipelineStageName', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'stage', ''), '')) IN ('booked', 'discovery scheduled', 'meeting requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_meeting,
      CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_name', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'pipelineStageName', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'stage', ''), '')) = 'closed won' OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'status', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'status', ''), '')) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_won
    FROM report_raw_ghl_opportunities o
    INNER JOIN contact_cohort cc ON cc.ghl_contact_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact.id', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contactId', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contact_id', ''))
  ) matched_opps
),
metric_summary AS (
  SELECT s.*, COALESCE(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0) AS opportunity_contact_count, COALESCE(f.meeting_contact_count, 0) AS meeting_contact_count, COALESCE(f.won_contact_count, 0) AS won_contact_count,
    COALESCE(c.cohort_contacts, 0) AS cohort_contacts, COALESCE(c.contacts_with_source_fields, 0) AS contacts_with_source_fields, COALESCE(c.contacts_with_bridge_match, 0) AS contacts_with_bridge_match, COALESCE(c.contacts_with_sale_match, 0) AS contacts_with_sale_match,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sessions, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(s.contacts_created, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.sessions, 0), 4) END AS session_to_contact_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.contacts_created, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.contacts_created, 0), 4) END AS contact_to_opportunity_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(f.meeting_contact_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0), 4) END AS opportunity_to_meeting_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.meeting_contact_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(f.won_contact_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(f.meeting_contact_count, 0), 4) END AS meeting_to_closed_won_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sessions, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(s.form_submissions, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.sessions, 0), 4) END AS session_to_form_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.cohort_contacts, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(c.contacts_with_source_fields, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(c.cohort_contacts, 0), 4) END AS contact_source_coverage_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.cohort_contacts, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(c.contacts_with_bridge_match, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(c.cohort_contacts, 0), 4) END AS contact_bridge_match_rate,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4) ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(c.contacts_with_sale_match, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(f.opportunity_contact_count, 0), 4) END AS opportunity_match_coverage_rate
  FROM summary s CROSS JOIN funnel_contacts f CROSS JOIN coverage c
),
channels AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.sessions DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    SELECT channel, traffic_source, source, medium, SUM(sessions)::int AS sessions, SUM(users)::int AS users, SUM(new_users)::int AS new_users, SUM(leads)::int AS leads, SUM(opportunities)::int AS opportunities, COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_revenue), 0)::numeric(18,2) AS closed_won_revenue
    FROM report_channel_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date GROUP BY channel, traffic_source, source, medium ORDER BY SUM(sessions) DESC LIMIT 8
  ) t
),
utm_breakdown AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.sessions DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    SELECT source, medium, campaign, content, landing_page, SUM(sessions)::int AS sessions, SUM(leads)::int AS leads, SUM(opportunities)::int AS opportunities, COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_revenue), 0)::numeric(18,2) AS closed_won_revenue
    FROM report_utm_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date GROUP BY source, medium, campaign, content, landing_page ORDER BY SUM(sessions) DESC LIMIT 15
  ) t
),
meta_contact_attribution AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.contacts DESC, t.opportunities DESC, t.booked_contacts DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    WITH meta_contacts AS (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(c.payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'utmSessionSource', ''), NULLIF(c.payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'source', ''), NULLIF(c.payload_json->>'source', ''), '') AS source,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(c.payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'medium', ''), '') AS medium,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(c.payload_json->'attributions'->0->>'campaign', ''), '') AS campaign,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_last', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_content_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_content_last', ''), '') AS content,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_last', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_landing_page_first', ''), NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'utm_landing_page_last', ''), '') AS landing_page,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), REPLACE(c.source_key, 'contact:', '')) AS ghl_contact_id
      FROM report_raw_ghl_contacts c
      WHERE DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(c.payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(c.payload_json->>'dateAdded', '')::timestamptz, NOW())) BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    ),
    matched_opps AS (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'contact.id', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contactId', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'contact_id', '')) AS ghl_contact_id,
        o.source_key AS opportunity_id,
        CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_name', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'pipelineStageName', ''), NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'stage', ''), '')) IN ('booked', 'discovery scheduled', 'meeting requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_booked
      FROM report_raw_ghl_opportunities o
      WHERE DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(o.payload_json->>'lastStatusChangeAt', '')::timestamptz, NOW())) BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    )
    SELECT
      NULLIF(mc.source, '') AS source,
      NULLIF(mc.medium, '') AS medium,
      NULLIF(mc.campaign, '') AS campaign,
      NULLIF(mc.content, '') AS content,
      NULLIF(mc.landing_page, '') AS landing_page,
      COUNT(DISTINCT mc.ghl_contact_id)::int AS contacts,
      COUNT(DISTINCT mo.opportunity_id)::int AS opportunities,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mo.is_booked = 1 THEN mc.ghl_contact_id END)::int AS booked_contacts
    FROM meta_contacts mc
    LEFT JOIN matched_opps mo ON mo.ghl_contact_id = mc.ghl_contact_id
    WHERE mc.ghl_contact_id <> ''
      AND (
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.source, '')) IN ('facebook', 'instagram', 'meta', 'fb', 'ig', 'an') OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.medium, '')) LIKE '%facebook%' OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.medium, '')) LIKE '%instagram%' OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.medium, '')) LIKE '%meta%' OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.medium, '')) LIKE '%leadform%' OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(mc.campaign, '')) LIKE '%meta%' OR
        COALESCE(mc.landing_page, '') LIKE '%utm_id=%' OR
        COALESCE(mc.landing_page, '') LIKE '%utm_source=an%'
      )
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT mc.ghl_contact_id) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT mo.opportunity_id) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mo.is_booked = 1 THEN mc.ghl_contact_id END) DESC
    LIMIT 12
  ) t
),
stage_daily AS (
  SELECT x.report_date, x.pipeline, x.stage, x.stage_count, GREATEST(x.stage_count - COALESCE(x.prev_stage_count, 0), 0)::int AS moved_in_count, GREATEST(COALESCE(x.prev_stage_count, 0) - x.stage_count, 0)::int AS moved_out_count, x.won_count, x.lost_count
  FROM (
    SELECT report_date, pipeline, stage, stage_count, won_count, lost_count, LAG(stage_count) OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline, stage ORDER BY report_date) AS prev_stage_count FROM report_stage_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
  ) x
),
pipelines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.moved_out_count DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    SELECT pipeline, SUM(stage_count)::int AS stage_count, SUM(moved_in_count)::int AS moved_in_count, SUM(moved_out_count)::int AS moved_out_count, SUM(won_count)::int AS won_count, SUM(lost_count)::int AS lost_count FROM stage_daily GROUP BY pipeline ORDER BY SUM(moved_out_count) DESC, SUM(stage_count) DESC
  ) t
),
stages AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.moved_out_count DESC, t.stage_count DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    SELECT pipeline, stage, SUM(stage_count)::int AS stage_count, SUM(moved_in_count)::int AS moved_in_count, SUM(moved_out_count)::int AS moved_out_count, SUM(won_count)::int AS won_count, SUM(lost_count)::int AS lost_count FROM stage_daily GROUP BY pipeline, stage ORDER BY SUM(moved_out_count) DESC, SUM(stage_count) DESC LIMIT 10
  ) t
),
health AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.source_system), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
    SELECT source_system, status, last_success_at, last_attempt_at, last_row_count, stale_after_hours, last_error FROM report_source_health WHERE source_system <> 'undefined' ORDER BY source_system
  ) t
),
social_posts AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'totalPosts', COUNT(*)::int,
    'publishedCount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('published','scheduled'))::int,
    'failedCount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) = 'failed')::int,
    'facebookCount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(platform) LIKE '%facebook%' OR LOWER(platform) = 'fb')::int,
    'instagramCount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(platform) LIKE '%instagram%' OR LOWER(platform) = 'ig')::int,
    'linkedinCount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(platform) LIKE '%linkedin%' OR LOWER(platform) = 'li')::int,
    'totalLikes', COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((insights->>'likes')::int, 0)), 0),
    'totalComments', COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((insights->>'comments')::int, 0)), 0),
    'totalShares', COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((insights->>'shares')::int, 0)), 0)
  ) AS payload
  FROM report_raw_ghl_social_posts
),
landing_pages AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0)::int AS item_count, COALESCE(SUM(sessions), 0)::int AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(form_submissions), 0)::int AS form_submissions FROM report_landing_page_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
),
summary_json AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'traffic', CASE WHEN (SELECT sessions FROM metric_summary) > 0 THEN (SELECT sessions FROM metric_summary)::text ELSE 'GA4 pending' END,
    'leads', (SELECT contacts_created FROM metric_summary)::text,
    'sales', (SELECT closed_won_count FROM metric_summary)::text,
    'trafficNumeric', (SELECT sessions FROM metric_summary), 'leadsNumeric', (SELECT contacts_created FROM metric_summary), 'salesNumeric', (SELECT closed_won_count FROM metric_summary), 'closedWonRevenue', (SELECT closed_won_revenue FROM metric_summary), 'users', (SELECT users FROM metric_summary), 'newUsers', (SELECT new_users FROM metric_summary), 'engagedSessions', (SELECT engaged_sessions FROM metric_summary), 'engagementRate', (SELECT engagement_rate FROM metric_summary), 'gscClicks', (SELECT gsc_clicks FROM metric_summary), 'gscImpressions', (SELECT gsc_impressions FROM metric_summary), 'gscCtr', (SELECT gsc_ctr FROM metric_summary), 'gscPosition', (SELECT gsc_position FROM metric_summary), 'contactsCreated', (SELECT contacts_created FROM metric_summary), 'formSubmissions', (SELECT form_submissions FROM metric_summary), 'opportunitiesCreated', (SELECT opportunities_created FROM metric_summary), 'opportunityContactCount', (SELECT opportunity_contact_count FROM metric_summary), 'meetingsBooked', (SELECT meetings_booked FROM metric_summary), 'closedWonCount', (SELECT closed_won_count FROM metric_summary), 'closedLostCount', (SELECT closed_lost_count FROM metric_summary), 'sessionToContactRate', (SELECT session_to_contact_rate FROM metric_summary), 'contactToOpportunityRate', (SELECT contact_to_opportunity_rate FROM metric_summary), 'opportunityToMeetingRate', (SELECT opportunity_to_meeting_rate FROM metric_summary), 'meetingToClosedWonRate', (SELECT meeting_to_closed_won_rate FROM metric_summary), 'sessionToFormRate', (SELECT session_to_form_rate FROM metric_summary), 'contactSourceCoverageRate', (SELECT contact_source_coverage_rate FROM metric_summary), 'contactBridgeMatchRate', (SELECT contact_bridge_match_rate FROM metric_summary), 'opportunityMatchCoverageRate', (SELECT opportunity_match_coverage_rate FROM metric_summary), 'cohortContacts', (SELECT cohort_contacts FROM metric_summary), 'contactsWithSourceFields', (SELECT contacts_with_source_fields FROM metric_summary), 'contactsWithBridgeMatch', (SELECT contacts_with_bridge_match FROM metric_summary), 'contactsWithSaleMatch', (SELECT contacts_with_sale_match FROM metric_summary), 'trafficGapLandingPages', (SELECT item_count FROM landing_pages), 'trafficGapSessions', (SELECT sessions FROM landing_pages), 'trafficGapFormSubmissions', (SELECT form_submissions FROM landing_pages)
  ) AS payload
)
SELECT json_build_object('window', json_build_object('from', $1::date, 'to', $2::date), 'summary', (SELECT to_jsonb(summary_json.payload) FROM summary_json), 'channelBreakdown', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM channels), '[]'::json), 'utmBreakdown', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM utm_breakdown), '[]'::json), 'metaAttribution', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM meta_contact_attribution), '[]'::json), 'pipelineDropoff', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM pipelines), '[]'::json), 'stageDropoff', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM stages), '[]'::json), 'stageVelocity', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(v.*) ORDER BY v.avg_days_in_stage DESC), '[]'::json) FROM report_stage_velocity_summary v), 'socialPosts', COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(social_posts.payload) FROM social_posts), '{}'::jsonb), 'health', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM health), '[]'::json)) AS payload;` } }];
